The bond changes: C=O broken, C=C broken, C-O formed, C-C formed. Bonds format expects atomic numbers? For example "6-8" meaning C-O? Actually O is atomic number 8. So C-O is "6-8". C-C is "6-6". So we should use bonds_formed ["6-8","6-6"], bonds_broken ["6-8","6-6"]? Wait broken C=O is "6-8". Broken C=C is "6-6". So bonds_broken ["6-8","6-6"], bonds_formed ["6-8","6-6"] same? But need order changed? Actually both broken and formed same types but different bonds. Use that.
